title: Automation’s Early Footprint: The ATE Dataset
facebook: You've probably heard a lot about 'AI automation' — but here's the truth: a new study of nearly 700,000 AI tools found only about 2.6% actually do your work for you. The rest help you work, but don't replace you. Here's what that means for you. https://aiworldhq.com/article/what-ai-automation-really-means-and-why-most-of-it-isn-t-there-yet
image_idea: A simple illustration showing a person at a desk with two options — one labeled 'helps you work' and one labeled 'does your work' — with a small checkmark on only the second option.
